title: Wiki · round 2 · a folder that has its own page
intro: Claude Design, 17 Nov. How a folder with an index.md shows in the tree, on the Mac and in the Companion.

A · Page with children: the folder becomes a page row with a chevron, labelled with the page title; top-level folders stop being section labels. B · Folder with a mark: keeps the folder name plus a small page glyph; section labels become selectable everywhere (what the branch built). C · Heading + first row (designer's pick): section labels stay plain headings; a top-level folder's page is the first row under its label; a nested folder is one row (chevron · folder-page icon · title); click opens and unfolds, the chevron only folds.

Extras in C: a "Wiki / guides /" breadcrumb above the title (new header prop), "In this folder · n" at the top of the margin column, "Page in this folder ⌘⇧N". Companion: iPad, the row opens the page and a 44 pt disclosure button folds it; iPhone, the folder pushes a list whose first row is its page.
